auth.title: Sign in

auth.driversAndCustomers: Drivers and customers use the mobile app.

orders.title: Orders
orders.boardDescription: Everything the laundry is working on, by stage. Each ticket shows how long it has waited and its one next step.
orders.listDescription: Search every order by number, customer name or phone.

orders.waitingOnCustomer: Waiting for the customer to choose how to pay
orders.noResultsBody: Try a different number, name or phone, or clear the filters.
orders.awaitingPaymentNote: The invoice is with the customer. Cleaning starts when they choose how to pay.

actions.driverLoad: {count, plural, =0 {No open stops} one {# open stop} other {# open stops}}
actions.notifiesPickup: The driver gets a new pickup and the customer is told a driver is assigned.
actions.notifiesDelivery: The driver gets a new delivery and the customer is told their order is on the way.
actions.assignPickupDriverBody: The order moves to Pickup scheduled.
actions.reassignPickupDriverBody: The new driver gets the pickup; the order stays scheduled.
actions.markCleanedBody: Confirm the items are clean and packed, then choose who delivers them.
actions.markCleanedDone: Order {number} is out for delivery with {driver}
actions.retryDeliveryBody: Choose who delivers it this time. Check the failure note first.
actions.receiveBodyShop: Do this when the bags are in your hands.
actions.receiveBodyWizard: Do this when the bags are in your hands.

actions.receiveConsequenceShop2: The customer is told cleaning has started.
actions.receiveConsequenceWizard1: The order moves to Count & invoice.

conditions.title: Condition report
conditions.none: Checked at sorting. No stains or damage found.
conditions.acknowledged: The customer confirmed they reviewed this report.
conditions.notAcknowledged: The customer hasn't reviewed this report yet.

invoiceForm.title: Count & invoice
invoiceForm.addCustom: Add an item not in the list
invoiceForm.conditionBody: Record any stains or existing damage before cleaning. The customer sees this first on the invoice and must confirm it before paying.
invoiceForm.noFindings: Checked. No stains or damage found.
invoiceForm.codFeeNote: If the customer pays on delivery, a {fee} fee is added.
invoiceForm.previewFindings: {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} will be shown before payment
invoiceForm.previewNoFindings: The invoice will say nothing was found
invoiceForm.previewConditionMissing: The condition report isn't recorded yet
invoiceForm.issueNeeds: Count at least one item and record the condition report.
invoiceForm.confirmBody: The customer is notified and asked to pay. The price can't be changed afterwards.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.pageDescription: Everything that needed the laundry's attention, newest first.

itemsPickedUp.title: Items collected
itemsPickedUp.body: Order {number} is on its way to the laundry

pickupFailed.title: Pickup failed
pickupFailed.body: Order {number} couldn't be collected and was cancelled

deliveryFailed.title: Delivery failed
deliveryFailed.body: Order {number} came back. Send it out again.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening tell your admin.
errors.staleOrder: This order changed while you were looking at it. The page has been refreshed.
errors.orderNotFound: This order no longer exists or belongs to another laundry.
errors.driverNotFound: That driver isn't active any more. Choose another.

errors.alreadyInvoiced: This order has already been invoiced.
errors.cancelReasonRequired: Say why the order is being cancelled.
errors.conditionReportRequired: Record the condition report: add findings or confirm there are none.

errors.inUse: This is used by existing orders, so it can only be hidden, not deleted.
